method: Conservative full-text review requiring the raising of Lazarus in John 11 to be a primary or major sustained subject of each post.

topic.name: Raising of Lazarus
topic.description: Examines John's account of Jesus raising Lazarus, especially its comparison with the Synoptic raising of Jairus' daughter and what the story reveals about John's portrayal of Jesus' signs and identity.
notes: All four posts substantially compare the raising of Lazarus with the raising of Jairus' daughter.
The posts are closely related versions of the same underlying discussion, but the subject is central in each.
Posts about the rich man and Lazarus, Mary and Martha, Gospel authorship, or the Signs Source were excluded unless the raising itself was a major sustained subject.
The broader Lazarus secondary keyword remains unchanged.
